title: Operator dispatch table
prompt: Implement `static int Eval(char op, int a, int b)` using a dispatch table of `Func<int, int, int>` (dictionary from char to function): '+' '−' '*' '/' (integer division). Unknown operator → `ArgumentException`. Division by zero propagates naturally.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Four keys, four functions — no if-chains.

tests.name: unknown
tests.hint: Missing keys throw; arithmetic errors are not swallowed.
